engineering_objective: Complete a crash-safe embedded transactional store so concurrency, MVCC visibility, conflict handling, WAL recovery, checkpointing, snapshot integrity, operator state, configuration and protocol boundaries agree across restart and maintenance cycles.

root_cause_clusters.RC_LOCK: The writer-lock lifecycle opens the lock file without actually acquiring the required process-wide exclusive advisory lock.
root_cause_clusters.RC_MVCC: Committed point reads and base scans resolve visibility against the latest commit sequence rather than each transaction's begin snapshot.
root_cause_clusters.RC_SCAN_OVERLAY: Prefix scans return only the committed base view and do not compose the transaction-local put/delete overlay.
root_cause_clusters.RC_CONFLICT: Commit publishes stale writes without first-committer-wins arbitration over keys changed after the transaction snapshot.
root_cause_clusters.RC_RECOVERY: WAL recovery can synthesize uncommitted mutation groups and classifies complete structural/checksum corruption as a repairable tail.
root_cause_clusters.RC_CHECKPOINT_INTEGRITY: Checkpoint/snapshot maintenance does not consistently enforce quiescence, reclaim the WAL, verify published rows, or clean abandoned temporary state.
root_cause_clusters.RC_HEALTH: Operator health reporting is built from hard-coded live/snapshot fields rather than the reachable transaction and storage state.
root_cause_clusters.RC_RUST_INTERFACE: The Rust control plane applies the wrong precedence and inclusive-boundary policies at configuration/protocol ingress.

defects.observable_failure: LOCK is opened but not held with an exclusive advisory lock
defects.partial_fix_trap: Creating the file alone does not fence another writer process.

defects.observable_failure: a second writer can open the same database directory while the first is live
defects.partial_fix_trap: Higher-level open success is not equivalent to kernel-held writer fencing or clean release semantics.

defects.observable_failure: a point reader observes a replacement committed after BEGIN
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing scans alone leaves point reads bound to latest state.

defects.observable_failure: a point reader loses a key deleted after BEGIN
defects.partial_fix_trap: Handling newer puts without tombstone snapshot visibility remains incorrect.

defects.observable_failure: a prefix scan acquires a row inserted after BEGIN
defects.partial_fix_trap: Adding local overlay to a latest-state base scan still leaks future commits.

defects.observable_failure: a prefix scan loses a row deleted after BEGIN
defects.partial_fix_trap: A scan must select its committed base at the transaction snapshot before overlay composition.

defects.observable_failure: a transaction-local put is absent from its own prefix scan
defects.partial_fix_trap: Point-read local visibility does not automatically provide scan overlay semantics.

defects.observable_failure: a transaction-local delete does not suppress the committed row in its own prefix scan
defects.partial_fix_trap: Overlay logic must distinguish tombstones from value replacements.

defects.observable_failure: a stale put commits over a newer committed version
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking conflicts after durable publication is too late.

defects.observable_failure: a stale delete commits after the key was changed by a newer transaction
defects.partial_fix_trap: Conflict arbitration must cover deletes as well as value writes.

defects.observable_failure: a multi-key stale transaction publishes instead of being rejected atomically
defects.partial_fix_trap: Per-key handling can leak unrelated writes from an otherwise stale transaction.

defects.observable_failure: a stale conflicting transaction consumes a commit sequence instead of ending with no new durable sequence
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sequence allocation must happen only after the whole write set passes arbitration.

defects.observable_failure: mutations from a process killed before COMMIT become visible after restart
defects.partial_fix_trap: EOF pending-mutation synthesis converts an incomplete transaction into committed history.

defects.observable_failure: rolled-back mutation records become visible after restart
defects.partial_fix_trap: Recovery must require a matching durable COMMIT rather than treat pending groups as completed transactions.

defects.observable_failure: a complete WAL record with checksum corruption is silently truncated as a torn tail
defects.partial_fix_trap: Only incomplete final bytes are repairable; a complete bad checksum must fail closed.

defects.observable_failure: a complete WAL record with invalid magic is silently discarded as a torn tail
defects.partial_fix_trap: A complete invalid header is corruption, not an incomplete crash tail.

defects.observable_failure: checkpoint succeeds while a transaction is active
defects.partial_fix_trap: Maintenance publication must not race an unfinished transaction lifecycle.

defects.observable_failure: successful checkpoint leaves prior WAL bytes instead of reclaiming the log
defects.partial_fix_trap: Syncing without truncation does not satisfy checkpoint reclamation.

defects.observable_failure: snapshot row checksum corruption is accepted on open
defects.partial_fix_trap: Reading a stored CRC without comparing it leaves corrupted rows trusted.

defects.observable_failure: bytes trailing the declared snapshot rows are accepted
defects.partial_fix_trap: A valid row prefix is insufficient unless the parser consumes the entire published image.

defects.observable_failure: an abandoned snapshot.tmp is left behind on the next open
defects.partial_fix_trap: Interrupted maintenance state must be discarded without replacing the published snapshot.

defects.observable_failure: HEALTH reports zero active transactions even while a transaction is open
defects.partial_fix_trap: Durable catalog state alone cannot represent live transaction reachability.

defects.observable_failure: HEALTH reports snapshot absent after a checkpoint has published snapshot.dat
defects.partial_fix_trap: Snapshot status must derive from published storage state rather than a constant.

defects.observable_failure: STONEVAULT_DATA overrides an explicitly supplied --data-dir
defects.partial_fix_trap: Configuration source precedence is part of the public operator contract and must be resolved before engine open.

defects.observable_failure: inputs exactly at the documented decoded key/prefix/value limits are rejected
defects.partial_fix_trap: An exclusive boundary predicate incorrectly rejects all three inclusive public limits.

cross_component: Rust ingress policy plus storage ownership
